run_printable_codegen: run the script to generate C++ is_printable function from Unicode data
run_get_codepoints: run get_codepoints to parse UnicodeData.txt and yield Codepoint namedtuples with value and class
run_to_ranges: run to_ranges to convert a sequence of integers into contiguous ranges of tuples
run_compress_singletons: run compress_singletons to encode a list of codepoints into upper byte groups and lower bytes
run_compress_normal: run compress_normal to encode start/count range pairs into variable-length byte entries
